moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Old friends are the best friends. Jensen rocks. The Star Mind computer… is far better than almost anyone expects and will reach volume production next year.
moments.why: Major buzz as it signals SpaceX–Nvidia space‑AI push hitting mass production in 2027.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: The Star Mind computer… will reach volume production next year. Working with the incredibly talented Nvidia engineering team is pure joy!
moments.why: Emphasizes deep collaboration and optimism around the high‑impact hardware venture.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: SpaceX, in partnership with Nvidia… AI data center launches could get underway as soon as the fourth quarter of next year.
moments.why: Adds timeline context—Orbits‑AI deployments expected Q4 2027; thread generating tech‑heavy speculation.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: 99.99% of compute will eventually move to space.
moments.why: A jaw‑dropping long‑term vision that’s sparking debates across tech and finance circles.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: SpaceX will exclusively use Nvidia GPUs 'because they are the best'… optimized Vera Rubin NVL72 will be launched into space next year.
moments.why: Confirms exclusive Nvidia hardware use and orbit‑ready compute plan—big for infrastructure devs.
